name: NG Natural Gas March Seasonality Analysis
description: Analyzes where Henry Hub Natural Gas (NG continuous futures) sits relative to its seasonal norms for March. Compares the 2025/2026 YTD price path (Jan-Mar) against the 10+ year historical average path, shows historical March return distributions, and provides key seasonal statistics including current z-score vs historical March distribution.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NG NATURAL GAS — MARCH SEASONALITY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# How does NG's 2026 YTD path compare to historical seasonal norms?
#
# Chart 1 (xy_lines): 2026 & 2025 YTD path vs historical avg + min/max range
# Chart 2 (xy_bars): March return for each year (bar per year)
# Chart 3 (histogram): Distribution of all historical March returns
# Cards (summary_table): Current March return, historical avg, win rate, z-score
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Source (daily, backward-adjusted for continuous series) ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Date Components ---
bar_ts = index()
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(bar_ts)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(bar_ts)
day_of_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_year)(bar_ts)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 1: YTD CUMULATIVE RETURN PATH (Jan 1 through end of March)
# =============================================================================

# Year-open price: first close of each year, forward-filled
is_new_year = year_num != (year_num >> 1)
yr_open = ffill(close if is_new_year else 0.0 / 0.0)
ytd_ret = close / yr_open - 1

# Filter to Jan-Mar window only (day_of_year roughly 1-90)
is_jan_mar = month_num <= 3

# Current year (2026) path
is_2026 = year_num == 2026 and is_jan_mar
ytd_2026 = where(is_2026, ytd_ret)

# Prior year (2025) path for comparison
is_2025 = year_num == 2025 and is_jan_mar
ytd_2025 = where(is_2025, ytd_ret)

# Historical years (2012-2024, 13 years for 10+ year history)
is_hist = year_num >= 2012 and year_num <= 2024 and is_jan_mar
ytd_hist = where(is_hist, ytd_ret)

# Day-of-year for x-axis (only within Jan-Mar window)
doy_filtered = where(is_jan_mar, day_of_year)

# --- Chart 1: YTD Path Comparison ---
xy_lines(
    title='NG Natural Gas: 2026 YTD Path vs Historical Seasonal Range',
    category='1. Seasonal Path',
    y_axis_label='Year-to-Date Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Day of Year',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfYear,
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2026 NG Path', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Last),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2025 NG Path', color=Color.Sky, agg=AggregationType.Last, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Historical Avg (2012-2024)', color=Color.Gray, agg=AggregationType.Mean),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Historical Max', color=Color.Emerald, agg=AggregationType.Max, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Historical Min', color=Color.Red, agg=AggregationType.Min, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(doy_filtered, ytd_2026, ytd_2025, ytd_hist, ytd_hist, ytd_hist)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 2: MARCH-SPECIFIC MONTHLY RETURNS
# =============================================================================

# Monthly data for March returns
src_m = market_data_source(timeframe=1M)()
cont_m = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1M,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src_m.o, src_m.h, src_m.l, src_m.c, src_m.v, src_m.oi, src_m.s)
close_m = cont_m.c

monthly_ret = returns(period=1, timeframe=1M)(close_m)

monthly_ts = index(timeframe=1M)
m_month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(monthly_ts)
m_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(monthly_ts)

# Filter to March only
is_march = m_month == 3
march_ret = where(is_march, monthly_ret)
march_year = where(is_march, m_year)

# March win indicator (1 if positive, 0 if negative)
march_win = where(is_march, 1 if monthly_ret > 0 else 0)

# Z-score of March returns (rolling over full history)
march_zscore = zscore(window=100, timeframe=1M)(march_ret)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 3: REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Cards: Key March Seasonality Statistics ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='NG March Seasonality Stats',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['March'],
        col_headers=['2026 March Return', 'Hist. Avg March Return', 'March Win Rate', 'Current Z-Score'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Emerald),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Indigo)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Seasonal Path',
    order=0
)(march_ret, march_ret, march_win, march_zscore)

# --- Chart 2: March Return by Year ---
xy_bars(
    title='NG March Return by Year: Which Years Were Bullish?',
    category='2. March Returns',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='March Return',
    x_axis_label='Year',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=march_ret, label=march_year)

# --- Chart 3: Distribution of Historical March Returns ---
histogram(
    title='Distribution of NG Historical March Returns',
    category='2. March Returns',
    bins=15,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='March Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=3
)(value=march_ret)
